test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given below to fill in the blank in the following sentence.

Toying

My cat, Mili loves ______ with the toy mouse.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' i.e. 'Playing'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Toying" **refers to move or handle (an object) absently or nervously, typically a small object or something one wears(खिलौने के साथ खेलना)

 
 
• **Example:** She was toying with her necklace during the interview.
 
 
 
• The word **"Playing"** describes the action of engaging in an activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose, which correlates with 'toying'. (खेलना)
 
 
• **Example:** Kids were playing in the park.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"Licking" **refers to passing the tongue over something in order to taste, moisten, or clean it.(चाटना)
 
• Option 2, **"Going"** refers to move from one place to another; travel. (जा रहा है).
 
• Option 3, **"Dancing"** means moving rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps. ("नाचना)
